result.reason: The grant covers Affiliates and contractors and permits transfer in an M&A transaction, but it does not fully reach the playbook position. It provides no perpetual, irrevocable treatment for paid-up licences, and the existing payment condition could permit loss of the licence without an uncured material breach. The transfer right also conflicts with subsection (c), which still prohibits assignment and transfer, while the contractor right may conflict with its outsourcing prohibition. In addition, “irrevocable during the term” is imprecise termination drafting, and subsection (e) incorrectly treats Affiliates and contractors as “individuals.”
